summary: Moz2D received correctness and portability fixes across drawing, image filters, and SIMD color conversions, including safer handling of `feConvolveMatrix`, CMYK math, big-endian pixel packing, and ARM NEON builds. Rectangle and region area calculations now use 64-bit values to avoid overflow, and surface replay works with more kinds of drawing targets. The result is more dependable rendering across platforms and unusual image or filter inputs.
